Welcome from our Headteacher
At Horsted we encourage our pupils to have high expectations of themselves and to try their very best – whatever their academic or creative abilities might be. It is important to us that the children are happy, confident, resilient and enjoy their learning; making the most of all the opportunities we have to offer. We ensure that all learning is purposeful and linked to children`s own experiences so they are engaged and challenged. Our staff are committed to providing the best education and support for our children and we actively encourage them to develop the independence to think for themselves and make thoughtful decisions about their actions.
